payload.text: (2026-09-18 16:18Z) LAMPLIGHT LANDED THROUGH THE KIT, AND THREE RULINGS ON THE WAY (vc, under the pen). THE REPAIR: ic's canon repair at 36a7b3fde through Lamplight's own gate, one commit rather than the two ordered because the gate refuses any commit while a doctor finding stands; vc read its 8 files against the order (the one-token AT-16.1 label, the AT re-cite with its event file, ST0340/0341/0342's links to ST0356 with the Unresolved tails cut, ST0315's view, ST0347's stale acceptance.md gone). THE STOP: the kit stopped at rc 4 at organize --apply on nine unheld v2 files, ST0037's WP/_superseded/{01..08,MVP}/info.md; ST0001's six did not block (five held by content, the cover is the thread). RULING 1, the name: `address::parse` refuses `info.md` as a segment at any depth while `Project::classify` calls a depth-4 one an Attachment, `attachment_name` round-trips through the parser, and the v2 prune holds a disk file by attachment NAME then sha256; so the nine could never be attached under their names and the door is a one-token rename on disk (info.md to spec.md) and an attach under that name, every authored byte kept in canon; ic did it, vc verified nine rows by name and sha against the disk and the preview at 0 refused. cc filed the classify/parser disagreement as 0461 (low) beside the related-links verb as 0460 (medium), both at 022298dfc with bodies byte-exact to their banks, both the next line's. RULING 2, the finish: the kit gains ONE resume mode (dc, refs/bank/dc/trawl/trawl-estate.sh 8cfac07a2 with split.md 9d258fcc6, judged green by vc as the diff of the two blobs) that finishes any stopped run from step 3, organize onward, the rc 7 branch folded into it because organize is idempotent; Lamplight lands kit-shaped like the twenty, never by hand steps. KNOWN LIMIT, ruled no order: the kit's 3c deletion witness skips any deleted info.md path because its case glob crosses slashes, so a v2 bucket's deeper info.md is witnessed by the prune's own name-and-sha gate alone, which is the gate that withheld the nine. RULING 3, carried forward from todo 44: a hand edit of canon taken by `intent sync --apply` is the door where no verb writes a field, bounded to the entries, with the verb filed. LANDED: Lamplight 2d862c19d on main through the kit's resume from 36a7b3fde (the v2 tree pruned whole, 368 event files backfilled, doctor 0 in the kit's own run), checked by vc (HEAD, empty status, no intent/events.jsonl, the v2 buckets gone, doctor 0, the nine spec.md rows in store and canon, no upstream configured); the 48 files left under intent/.treeindex/ are untracked, gitignored and stamped 2026-03, the retired v2 command's local cache and no run's writing. THE FLEET: 21 of 22 estates trawled, committed in their own repos and checked; Devbin alone remains, dc's when its own nodes fold (decision 47). NO PUSH.
